svg.title: GECC: conditional losses against one bank net-assets floor
svg.desc: Frozen June 30, 2026. Net assets equal 110.418 million dollars less the stipulated loss. Writing off all selected holdings leaves 87.107 million. The 80 million bank floor is reached at 30.418 million loss. This is not a bankruptcy line, a probability distribution, or a certificate of other coverage, borrowing-base or cash requirements.
